## 1 — Setup (once per computer)

**Install:**

- **VS Code** — [code.visualstudio.com](https://code.visualstudio.com) (tick **"Add to PATH"** during setup)
- **Quarto CLI** — [quarto.org/docs/get-started](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/)
- **Quarto extension** for VS Code — search "Quarto" in the Extensions sidebar

**Create the project:**

**File → New File… → Quarto Project → Website Project** → choose your folder. Quarto creates:

- `_quarto.yml` — site-wide settings
- `index.qmd` — your homepage
- `about.qmd` — an example second page
- `styles.css` — optional custom styling

**Preview while you work:** click the **Preview** button (top-right of the editor), or run `quarto preview` in the Terminal. Save any file — the preview updates live.

## 2 — Writing & editing content

Every page is a `.qmd` file: a **YAML header**, then a **Markdown body** with optional **code cells**.

**Site-wide YAML** (`_quarto.yml`) controls navigation and theme for the whole site:

```yaml
website:
  title: "My Site"
  navbar:
    left:
      - text: "About"
        href: about.qmd
```

**Page-level YAML** (top of each `.qmd`) overrides settings for that one page:

```yaml
---
title: "My Page"
format: html
filters:
  - parmsam/quizdown
---
```

**Markdown body basics:**

| Syntax | Result |
|---|---|
| `## Heading` | Section heading |
| `**bold**`, `*italic*` | **bold**, *italic* |
| `[text](url)` | Link |
| `![](path.png)` | Image |
| `$x^2$`, `$$x^2$$` | Inline / block math |

**Callouts** flag information visually:

```markdown
::: {.callout-tip}
## Tip
Use tips for best-practice advice.
:::
```

Types: `.callout-note`, `.callout-tip`, `.callout-warning`, `.callout-important`.

**Code cells** run and/or display code:

````markdown

::: {.cell execution_count=1}

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
Hello!
```
:::
:::


````

Common cell options (as `#|` comments): `echo`, `eval`, `warning`, `error`, `output`.

## 3 — Publish with GitHub Pages

1. In `_quarto.yml`, under `project:`, add `output-dir: docs`
2. Render: `quarto render`
3. Create a **public** repository on [github.com](https://github.com)
4. Upload the whole project folder (including `docs/`) and commit
5. Repo → **Settings → Pages** → Branch `main`, folder `/docs` → **Save**
6. Wait for the green checkmark under **Deployments** — your site is live at
   `https://<username>.github.io/<repo-name>/`

**Updating your site later:** run `quarto render` again, then re-upload the `docs/` folder to GitHub (or `git push` if you're using Git).
